uutiset.t: Sky announces Game Changing coalition for women and girls in sport
uutiset.s: Sky is pleased to announce the formation of the Game Changing coalition, a new UK initiative to drive lasting change for women and girls through increased participation in sport.

uutiset.t: Arsenal punished for bluntness in attack - but Man City also have problems
uutiset.s: Arsenal face Manchester City in a blockbuster Premier League contest this weekend, but in recent days and months, both teams have issues to overcome.

uutiset.t: 'You question everything' - Haaland lays City's frustrations bare
uutiset.s: Erling Haaland said Manchester City's poor form is affecting the players, admitting "when you don't win, you question everything" after they were held 2-2 at home by Napoli in the Champions League.

uutiset.t: Mourinho calls Bellingham best midfielder in the world - have your say!
Poch cites Eze as he questions Barcola role in Szoboszlai goal - is he right?
uutiset.s: Speaking ahead of his side's clash against Sporting Lisbon, Manchester United boss Mauricio Pochettino questioned Bradley Barcola's impact on Dominik Szoboszlai's freekick goal and made a comparison to Eberechi Eze's disallowed attempt from 2025.

uutiset.t: Wasteful Arsenal held by Borussia Dortmund
uutiset.s: Arsenal were punished for failing to take their chances for the second game in a row as Maximilian Beier clinched a 1-1 draw for Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League.

uutiset.t: Poch fumes at Yoro red and thinks Szoboszlai goal shouldn't have stood
uutiset.s: Mauricio Pochettino has heavily criticised VAR in Manchester United's loss at Liverpool after Leny Yoro's red card was overturned, while the Argentine believes Dominik Szoboszlai’s opener should not have stood.

Villa beaten late on at Galatasaray as winless run continues
uutiset.s: Aston Villa's winless run extended to six games as a late Deniz Gul's header saw them beaten 1-0 by Galatasaray in the Champions League league phase.

How 'quick check' and unseen angle saw Timber's Isak shirt-pull go unpunished
uutiset.s: Referees’ chief Howard Webb admitted it was a “quick check” by VAR for Arsenal defender Jurrien Timber’s unpunished shirt-pull on Liverpool striker Alexander Isak in the Gunners’ win at Anfield.

uutiset.t: Man Utd to contact PL and refs over 'totally wrong' Yoro red card interpretation
uutiset.s: Manchester United will contact ProRef and the Premier League directly over what they believe to be a 'totally wrong' interpretation of Leny Yoro's red card against Liverpool.
